description: This PHP source file generates a web interface for managing NAT (Network Address Translation) rules, including displaying existing NAT mappings, and providing functionality to add, edit, delete, and enable/disable NAT entries. It also includes JavaScript code for handling user interactions and AJAX requests to server-side scripts.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Fetches parameter values from the device configuration, returning NAT mapping array.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves string configuration values, such as enabling NAT or One-to-One NAT features.
